blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · How much sugar is in SkinnyDipped Dark…
blocks_element.text: How much sugar is in SkinnyDipped Dark Chocolate Coconut Almond Bites?

blocks_element.repere: Texte · SkinnyDipped Dark Chocolate Coconut Al…
blocks_element.text: SkinnyDipped Dark Chocolate Coconut Almond Bites contain just 3g of sugar per bite. They are sweetened with a small amount of cane sugar, maple sugar, tapioca syrup, and agave syrup, with no sugar alcohols or artificial sweeteners.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Do SkinnyDipped Dark Chocolate Coconut…
blocks_element.text: Do SkinnyDipped Dark Chocolate Coconut Almond Bites contain dairy?

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Yes. Dark Chocolate Coconut Almond Bit…
blocks_element.text: Yes. Dark Chocolate Coconut Almond Bites contain milk and are not suitable for a dairy-free diet. All SkinnyDipped products are also processed on shared equipment with dairy-containing products.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Are SkinnyDipped Dark Chocolate Coconu…
blocks_element.text: Are SkinnyDipped Dark Chocolate Coconut Almond Bites vegan?

blocks_element.repere: Texte · No. Dark Chocolate Coconut Almond Bite…
blocks_element.text: No. Dark Chocolate Coconut Almond Bites contain milk and are not suitable for a vegan diet. If you’re looking for a vegan SkinnyDipped option, our Super Dark + Sea Salt Almonds are our only vegan-friendly product.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · What is the difference between SkinnyD…
blocks_element.text: What is the difference between SkinnyDipped Coconut Almond Bites and the original Coconut Bites — did the recipe change?

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Yes — milk was recently added to our C…
blocks_element.text: Yes — milk was recently added to our Coconut Bites, and the product has been updated to Dark Chocolate Coconut Almond Bites to reflect the current recipe. If your package doesn’t list milk in the ingredients, it does not contain milk, we always make sure our labels match the product inside. If you have a dairy allergy and have any concerns about a specific batch, please reach out to us at
